        "b" => ("0b", format!("{byte:08b}")),
        "X" => ("0x", format!("{byte:02X}")),
        _ => ("0x", format!("{byte:02x}")),
    };

pub fn dump<W: Write>(
    out: &mut W,
    data: &[u8],
    columns: usize,
    format: &str,
    prefix: bool,
    color: bool,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let step = columns.max(1);
    let mut start: usize = 0;
    loop {
        write!(out, "0x{start:06x}: ")?;
        let end = start.saturating_add(step).min(data.len());
        let row = &data[start..end];
        for &byte in row {
            write!(out, "{} ", tint(&octet(byte, format, prefix), byte, color))?;
        }
        // Padding counts absent octets, not the chosen base's printed width.
        for _ in row.len()..columns {
            write!(out, "     ")?;
        }
        for &byte in row {
            let ch = if (32..=126).contains(&byte) {
                byte as char
            } else {
                '.'
            };
            write!(out, "{}", tint(&ch.to_string(), byte, color))?;
        }
        writeln!(out)?;
        if row.len() < step {
            break;
        }
        start = end;
    }
    writeln!(out, "   bytes: {}", data.len())
}

pub fn array<W: Write>(out: &mut W, data: &[u8], columns: usize, language: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
    let len = data.len();
    let (head, tail) = match language {
        "r" => (format!("let ARRAY: [u8; {len}] = ["), "];"),
        "c" => (format!("unsigned char ARRAY[{len}] = {{"), "};"),
        "g" => (format!("a := [{len}]byte{{"), "}"),
        "p" => ("a = [".to_owned(), "]"),
        "k" => ("val a = byteArrayOf(".to_owned(), ")"),
        "j" => ("byte[] a = new byte[]{".to_owned(), "};"),
        "s" => ("let a: [UInt8] = [".to_owned(), "]"),
        _ => ("let a = [|".to_owned(), "|]"),
    };
    writeln!(out, "{head}")?;
    write!(out, "    ")?;
    let mut count = 0;
    for (index, &byte) in data.iter().enumerate() {
        write!(out, "0x{byte:02x}")?;
        if language == "f" {
            write!(out, "uy")?;
        }
        if index + 1 < len || language == "g" {
            write!(out, "{} ", if language == "f" { ";" } else { "," })?;
        }
        count += 1;
        if count >= columns {
            write!(out, "\n    ")?;
            count = 0;
        }
    }
    writeln!(out, "\n{tail}")
}

    for i in 0..length {

        print!("{:.*},", places, angle.sin());
        if (i + 1) % 10 == 0 {
            println!();
        }
    }
    println!();
}

// Similarity is used only to offer a spelling hint, never to accept an option.
fn similarity(a: &str, b: &str) -> f64 {
    let a: Vec<_> = a.chars().collect();
    let b: Vec<_> = b.chars().collect();
    if a == b {
        return 1.0;
    }
    if a.is_empty() || b.is_empty() {
        return 0.0;
    }
    let radius = (a.len().max(b.len()) / 2).saturating_sub(1);
    let mut am = vec![false; a.len()];
    let mut bm = vec![false; b.len()];
    let mut matches = 0;
    for i in 0..a.len() {
        for j in i.saturating_sub(radius)..(i + radius + 1).min(b.len()) {
            if !bm[j] && a[i] == b[j] {
                am[i] = true;
                bm[j] = true;
                matches += 1;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if matches == 0 {
        return 0.0;
    }
    let mismatches = a
        .iter()
        .zip(&am)
        .filter(|(_, flag)| **flag)
        .map(|(c, _)| c)
        .zip(b.iter().zip(&bm).filter(|(_, flag)| **flag).map(|(c, _)| c))
        .filter(|(a, b)| a != b)
        .count();
    let m = matches as f64;
    let mut score =
        (m / a.len() as f64 + m / b.len() as f64 + (m - mismatches as f64 / 2.0) / m) / 3.0;
    if score > 0.7 {
        let common = a.iter().zip(&b).take(4).take_while(|(a, b)| a == b).count();
        score += common as f64 * 0.1 * (1.0 - score);
    }
    score
}

fn closest<'a>(value: &str, candidates: impl Iterator<Item = &'a str>) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut best = None;
    let mut score = 0.7;
    for (index, candidate) in candidates.enumerate() {
        let current = similarity(value, candidate);
        if current > 0.7 && current >= score {
            best = Some(index);
            score = current;
        }
    }
    best
}

        if value != "0" {
